previewDeathNotice.description:
The peaceful death has taken place on Wednesday 26th November 2025 at St. Vincent’s Hospital, Dublin of Seán Donnelly, Milltown, Dublin 6 and formerly from Cathedral Place, Letterkenny, Co. Donegal.  Deeply missed by his loving sisters Marie Kelly (Dublin), Frances Hughes (Dave) (Dublin), brother Leo (Sharon) (Letterkenny), nieces, nephew and a wide circle of family, friends and neighbours in Dublin and Letterkenny. 

 

Seán is predeceased by his wife Eilish, parents Frank and Eilís, sisters’ baby Elaine, Sue Lynch and Greta.

 

May Seán Rest in Peace

 

Seán’s remains will be reposing at his brother Leo’s residence at Cathedral Place, Letterkenny F92 RWK7 on Thursday 27th November from 1pm until 10pm with Rosary at 9pm.

 

Funeral on Friday 28th November 2025 in St. Eunan’s Cathedral, Letterkenny at 11am  and can be viewed live on www.churchservices.tv/letterkenny.  Interment afterwards in New Leck Cemetery, Letterkenny.

 

Family flowers only please.

 

If you would like to leave a message of condolence for the family, please do so by selecting ‘Condolences’ below.
